{{Quote|After all these years, we were beginning to think you weren't coming.|Taun We, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
'''Taun We''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who hailed from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] noted for its major [[Cloning/Legends|cloning facilities]]. As the administrative [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], she was closely involved in the creation of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[elite]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] bred to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
===Project Coordinator===
{{Quote|Welcome, little one. This is your first day. Your designation will be RC-01/138. We expect great things from you.|Taun We, to [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]|<ref name="SWRC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
Approximately [[32 BBY/Legends|ten years before]] the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="EpisodeII" /> Taun We and her [[Kaminoan/Legends|people]] were hired by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] to create a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In addition to her duties as administrative [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], she also served as [[Project Coordinator]] for the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. She closely monitored the development of the rank-and-file [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]],<ref name="DB" /> as well as the training of a [[Elite|special]] [[unit]] known as [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="SWRC" />

During the accelerated growth and training process of the clone troopers, Taun We also acted as a guardian to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], an unmodified clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="BFDB">{{DB|character|bobafett|Fett, Boba}}</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had been selected to become the army's [[Clone template/Legends|template]].<ref name="SWBH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Whereas Fett felt no emotional sentiments toward the rest of his copies, he regarded Boba as the only "true clone;" a son to be raised and cared for. With only two other [[Gender/Legends|female]] influences&mdash;[[MU-12]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]&mdash;in Boba's life,<ref name="BFDB" /><ref name="SW:ZW">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref> Taun We became a virtual "surrogate mother" to Fett's son.<ref name="BFDB" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Tell your Council that the first battalions are ready, and remind them, if they need more troops, it will take more time to grow them.|Taun We, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
[[File:TaunWeCW.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Taun We during the Clone Wars]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tracked Jango Fett to [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Kamino.<ref name="EpisodeII" /> Unaware of Kenobi's mission, Taun We assumed that he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representative sent to gather a progress report on the clone army.<ref name="DB" /> She and Lama Su personally escorted Kenobi on a tour through their [[clone military education complex]], proudly displaying the Kaminoans' creations to their Jedi guest. She then introduced Kenobi to Boba and Jango Fett, whom Kenobi deduced to be the hunter he was sent after. Before reporting his findings to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Kenobi was informed by Taun We that the battle-ready clone [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] were prepared for deployment, although additional [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] required more time to be grown.<ref name="EpisodeII" />

After [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] activated the clone troopers as the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|official army]], under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]], the Republic entered into a state of war&mdash;known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] rebellion.<ref name="EpisodeII" /> When the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist forces]] [[First Battle of Kamino|invaded]] Kamino in an attempt to destroy the Republic's primary cloning source, Taun We helped to coordinate the planet's defenses in order to protect the Kaminoan facilities. Although most of their remaining units were unfit for combat, as Taun We noted during the fighting, Kamino was ultimately spared from conquest by the combined efforts of Jedi and [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha''-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]].<ref name="Republic50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>

However, the true purpose of the Clone Wars was the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|eradication]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the creation of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] hegemony. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, publicly known as Chancellor Palpatine, issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hence declared all Jedi as enemies of the Republic. In the aftermath of the purge, Palpatine used the programmed loyalty of the clone troopers to enforce the rise of his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ruled by himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]].<ref name="EpisodeIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> The clones, reorganized into [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]], were used by the Empire to enforce the Emperor's reign on various worlds, including Taun We's homeworld of Kamino, which ultimately lost its independence as a result of its own creations.<ref name="BattlefrontII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

===Later years===
{{Quote|Would you kill me Boba?|Taun We, to Boba Fett|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
Following the end of the Clone Wars, Taun We lived through several long time periods such as the [[Imperialization/Legends|era of Imperialization]], the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Though she was still alive as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Taun We no longer served the government of Kamino; her planet having been reduced to a shadow of its former self. Employed by [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]], she was stationed in the company's facility on [[Vohai]] in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]]. By then, a much older and terminally-ill Boba Fett discovered Taun We's location and forced her to divulge any information that could reverse his condition.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Taun_We.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Taun We of Kamino]]
{{Quote|I must be fair to all. It is in my nature.|Taun We, to Boba Fett|<ref name="FightToSurvive">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref>}}
Taun We was polite and courteous, possessing a gentle nature<ref name="DB" /> that made her fair to everyone.<ref name="FightToSurvive" /> Tall and graceful, the female Kaminoan was considered beautiful and elegant; her personality and understanding of Human emotional psychology qualified her as the Project Coordinator for a Republic Army of Human clones. Yet despite being well-versed in Human behavior, Taun We was also naïve enough to not realize that Obi-Wan Kenobi did not know about the clone army's existence before his arrival on Kamino.<ref name="DB" /> Her talent for nurturing young clones aided in the development of a relationship between her and Boba Fett, who viewed her as the closest example he had to a mother figure.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taun We was an entirely computer-generated character. She was voiced by [[Rena Owen]], who described Taun We as a creature of love and light. Owen performed Taun We's voice on set, wearing a specially modified hardhat with a maquette of the alien's head on top, which provided her co-stars with the proper line-of-sight for talking with the two-meter tall alien.<ref name="DB" />

Taun We is a playable character in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', except in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version, where she appears as a non-playable character during the Kamino level, guiding the player.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
